notes: The breadboard in the image is drawn with rows f-j in the upper half; these map to catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j).

Hole positions read from the image: resistor in row h from column 3 to column 6; LED anode (long, bent leg) in column 6 and cathode in column 8, both in row i; orange wire from pin 13 to 3b.g; black wire from the GND pin beside AREF (GND.1) to 8b.g.
The resistor is 220 ohm per the manual and schematic.
The tutorial's optional external LED circuit is the one built here. The on-board pin-13 LED is not modelled.
